_note: Held-out identity acceptance set, frozen before data generation. Never used for training: scripts.gen_identity drops any training conversation whose user turn is a near-duplicate of a prompt here. Pass = every identity prompt's reply says the name, every unrelated reply says it 0 times, and no reply claims to be another model. A prompt is a string (one user turn) or a list of messages ending with the user's turn.
